description: Source code for the DynamicType class in PyTorch's ATen library, handling dynamic type representations, conversions, and type comparisons.

classes.name: DynamicType
classes.description: Represents a dynamic type in PyTorch, supporting type comparison, subtype checks, and fallback to concrete types.

classes.name: DynamicType::Arguments
classes.description: Holds arguments for DynamicType, including type parameters and labels.

classes.description: A labeled version of DynamicType used for subtype and equality checks.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the DynamicType.

methods.name: isSubtypeOfExt
